target.name: M. tuberculosis PknB Kinase
target.domain_rationale: Eukaryotic-like Ser/Thr kinase fold well represented across both Davis and BindingDB_Kd (target present in BindingDB_Kd).
target.disease_burden: 10.8M annual cases and 1.25M deaths globally (WHO); rising multidrug-resistant (MDR-TB) burden.
target.target_biology: Essential mycobacterial receptor-like Ser/Thr kinase controlling cell-wall peptidoglycan synthesis and division.
target.reference_note: Mitoxantrone and host-directed tyrosine kinase inhibitors (e.g. Imatinib) have published anti-mycobacterial / PknB research signal.
